title: Thermosensitive slurry electrolyte design for efficient electrochemical heat harvesting
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,2852-2860
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04976D, Paper
Pei Liu, Boyang Yu, Yilin Zeng, Yifan Zhang, Xuan Cai, Xue Long, Hua Jiang, Wendong Yang, Shuangyan Gui, Jinhua Guo, Jia Li, Jun Zhou, Jiangjiang Duan
A thermoelectrochemical cell for efficient waste heat harvesting is presented, utilizing a thermosensitive slurry electrolyte to co-optimize the temperature coefficient (α), specific charge capacity (qc) and specific heat capacity (cp).
